decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for resident meeting rooms and housing management office shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Erection of single storey infill extension, conversion of redundant garage space and undercroft parking areas to form residents meeting room/housing management office and caretakers stores at 14-15 Swift Road, and erection of boundary fencing along Swift Road from Crosby Close to Gabriel Close.
